meta.task: MICRO RECON - perceptual near-duplicate frame detection in unit sheets

method.grid: 8 columns (viewing directions) x N rows (animation frames); cell=width/8
method.fingerprint: each full-width row strip alpha-composited over white, resized to 32x32 grayscale LANCZOS, stored as bytes (base64 + sha1-8)
method.pairs: adjacent (neighbouring) rows; all-pairs also computed supplementary
method.motion_classification: full-res composited-strip MAE: exact if pixel-identical; near_static if MAE<0.003 and changed-frac(|d|>8)<0.001; else subtle_motion

deep_probe.note: No byte-identical adjacent frames exist anywhere in the corpus. The 0.02 32x32-grayscale threshold flags 96% of adjacent pairs, but full-resolution comparison shows >97% of those are genuine subtle motion; only near_static pairs are plausible static holds.

recommendation.verdict: DO NOT COLLAPSE based on the 0.02 threshold alone
rationale: At 32x32 grayscale the 0.02 normalized-MAE threshold is far too permissive: 1693/1762 (96%) adjacent pairs pass, including ordinary walk/idle/attack motion.
Full-resolution comparison finds ZERO exactly identical frames in 214 sheets; every flagged pair has real pixel differences (typical high-res MAE 0.01-0.03).
Only 129 near-static pairs across 33 sheets are even candidates, and even these show nonzero differences that may be intentional sub-pixel jitter or antialiasing.
Walk and attack dominate the raw near-dup counts, which is expected for smooth animation and is precisely where collapsing would be most damaging.
recommendation.conservative_action: Treat the 1119 MB 'all-drop' figure as an Unsafe upper bound, not realizable savings. If any action is taken, restrict it to a small, visually-verified subset of near_static idle/attack hold groups (e.g. chasseur_attack, highlander_attack, howitzer_attack, jannisary_attack, mortar_attack, musketeer_attack, pandur_attack) and only after frame-by-frame human review. Theoretical best case from these near-static groups is ~88.28125 MB raw (uncompressed RGBA); actual PNG file savings will be smaller and must account for the playback-map overhead.
